content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 7 vacancies available across 4 contractual posts.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicant must be a citizen of India.

rows.qualification_required: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Engineering / Technology or a related discipline, with at least 60% marks or an equivalent CGPA (or First Class where awarded by the Institute/University). (OR) Master’s degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Engineering / Technology or a related discipline, with at least 60% marks or an equivalent CGPA (or First Class where awarded by the Institute/University). Plus minimum 08 years of post-qualification relevant experience in enterprise software architecture, solution architecture, platform engineering, or large-scale systems development.

Bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (or First Class as defined by the awarding Institute/University). Plus minimum 03 years of post-qualification relevant experience, strong foundation in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, and hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI/ML application development.

Bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (or First Class as defined by the awarding Institute/University). Plus minimum 03 years of post-qualification relevant experience, strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), and hands-on experience with the MERN Stack.

Bachelor's degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (or First Class as defined by the awarding Institute/University). Plus minimum 02 years of post-qualification relevant experience, strong analytical and documentation skills, and experience with Agile methodologies and SDLC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment
content_sections.text: Access the online application portal under Temporary Positions on the official website at www.iith.ac.in/careers/ . Register on the online portal using a valid and active email ID and mobile number. Fill in personal information accurately as recorded in your 10th Standard or Matriculation certificate. Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph and signature in JPG/JPEG format (maximum size 1 MB). Add educational qualifications and upload relevant educational certificates in PDF format (maximum size 1 MB per document). Add employment details and upload relevant supporting documents in PDF format (maximum size 1 MB per document). Upload any additional certificates relevant to the post if applicable. Review all entered details carefully, accept the Declaration by selecting the checkbox, and complete the final submission to receive an automatic PDF copy of the application form via email.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: 10th Standard / Matriculation Certificate or Mark Sheet for Date of Birth proof Educational certificates and mark sheets (Bachelor's / Master's degree) Experience certificates on organisation letterhead stating designation, period of service, nature of work, and pay (bearing date of issue, name, designation, signature, and stamp of the issuing authority) Caste certificate in the prescribed Government of India format (OBC-NCL issued within the last two years, EWS for the current financial year), if applicable Ex-Servicemen certificate, if applicable PwBD certificate indicating disability of 40% or more, if applicable Valid photo identification proof

content_sections.text: Candidates are required to submit online applications only; offline applications will be summarily rejected. The cut-off date for reckoning upper age limit, qualification, and post-qualification experience is 30-10-2026. Part-time employment experience shall not be considered. Pay slips, office orders, or appointment orders shall not be considered as proof of experience. The appointment is purely temporary for 11 months, with possible extension subject to satisfactory performance and Institute requirements. Working hours are 8 hours per day, 6 days a week, with weekend/holiday work required when informed by authorities. Contractual employees are not eligible for campus residential accommodation except on a case-to-case basis on license fee payment. Selected candidates must possess and submit a valid health insurance policy for the engagement period obtained at their own expense. No Travelling Allowance (TA)/DA shall be paid for attending the selections.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (Advt. No. IITH/CS/60) inviting online applications for 7 contractual positions including Senior Architect, AI Engineer, MERN Full Stack Developer, and Business Analyst.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available across 4 posts: Senior Architect (1), AI Engineer (1), MERN Full Stack Developer (3), and Business Analyst (2).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 30-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for a Senior Architect?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Engineering / Technology or a related discipline with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA, plus a minimum of 8 years of post-qualification relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MERN Full Stack Developer?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for MERN Full Stack Developer is 40 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit online applications through the official careers portal at careers.iith.ac.in. Offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selections will be made through a Written Test, Skill Test, and/or Interview conducted at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary for an initial period of 11 months, with possible extension based on satisfactory performance and Institute requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is at the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad, located in Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana – 502284.
